pipeline.algorithm: SHA-256(namespace + ':' + hand_id); first 64 bits big-endian modulo 10000
pipeline.state_management: stateless: per-hand assignments are never persisted and are recomputed from hand_id

node_definition.description: Phase 1 base: only structural-node frequencies are active. Continuous board/sizing/SPR adjustments are intentionally disabled.

training.combo_policy_test: TEST revealed opponent cards metrics only
training.continuous_validation: VALIDATION selects feature group, spline/linear form, regularization and scale
training.continuous_test: TEST metrics only, evaluated after selection

flop_FREE.selection: TRAIN fit; VALIDATION feature/regularization/scale selection; TEST metrics only

flop_FACING.selection: TRAIN fit; VALIDATION feature/regularization/scale selection; TEST metrics only

methodology.marginals: Hierarchical backoff fitted only on TRAIN. Exact node is shrunk toward progressively broader contexts.
methodology.continuous_adjustment: Phase 5 leakage-free offset-multinomial residual around Phase-1 structural node probabilities. Only pre-decision observables are allowed: SPR, board features, and facing bet price. Own action size is explicitly excluded from marginal action prediction to prevent target leakage.
methodology.combo_policy: Phase 2: theory prior plus regularized multinomial residuals learned from revealed continuing hands. Per street/mode blend strength is selected only on VALIDATION; TEST is metrics-only.
methodology.range_update: Bayesian combo filtering remains available in the replayer, calibrated to these node marginals.
methodology.revealed_cards: Used only for relative composition among actions that can be observed with revealed cards (CHECK/BET/JAM or CALL/RAISE/JAM). Fold composition is not learned from revealed cards in Phase 2 because folded cards are selection-missing; Phase 3 FULL/MASKED simulation will quantify/correct this bias.
methodology.combo_features: Board-relative exact-combo features: evaluated made-hand score/category, pair type and kicker, flush/straight/combo draws, overcards, backdoors, ace suit blocker, pocket/suited hole cards, broad role/position/multiway context and selected interactions.
methodology.continuous_sizing: Facing price is modeled for FACING decisions. Own BET/RAISE size is not used to predict whether the actor bets/raises; observed own size remains available only to the combo-composition theory prior, where it conditions the range after the action is known.

flop_FREE.selection_bias_contract: Learned only among revealed continuing actions. Fold composition remains theory-anchored until Phase 3 FULL/MASKED correction.

incremental_update.marginal_update: full-weight additive evidence with historical posterior carry-forward mass old_n+40
